individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows representative fluorescence micrographs only, not a plot of averages.
The JC-1 (Green/Red ratio) and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar graphs (n=20) show only mean ± error bars with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a representative Western blot image, not a quantitative averages plot.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar graphs show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) noted in the bars, but no individual data points are plotted.

Panel E consists of FACS histograms displaying full cell-number distributions across TMRM intensity for each replicate, which already represent the underlying single-cell data rather than a summary average requiring individual point overlay.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - No error bars present in this panel of representative images.
FAIL - Bar graphs show error bars, but the caption only reports sample size and statistical significance thresholds; it never states what the error bars represent (e.g., SD or SEM).
PASS - No error bars present; this is a representative Western blot.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL - Bar graphs show error bars, but the caption only describes the statistical test and sample sizes, not the nature of the error bars (SD/SEM).
PASS - No error bars present; panel shows raw FACS histograms.
